apps.name: Steam
apps.notes: steamapps (games + userdata saves) are excluded by default; config/login is included. Games with Steam DRM still need Steam online.

apps.name: GameLoop
apps.notes: GameLoop/PUBG: imports the Tencent registry and creates PUBG Mobile.exe if UI\AndroidEmulatorEn.exe exists.

apps.name: Xbox App
apps.notes: UWP/MSIX Store app - not portable with this method.

apps.name: Microsoft Edge
apps.notes: System browser; portable copy may not update correctly.

apps.name: Microsoft Teams
apps.notes: New Teams is MSIX; classic Teams is a normal desktop app.

apps.name: Plex Media Server
apps.notes: Runs as a service; portable server use is limited.

apps.name: Visual Studio
apps.notes: Large install; copy mode is slow.

apps.name: Roblox
apps.notes: Uses versioned folders; run once before building.

apps.name: Sunshine
apps.notes: Runs as a service; needs admin.

apps.name: ExitLag
apps.notes: Needs a driver/service; not fully portable.

apps.name: NordVPN
apps.notes: Needs a service/TAP driver; not fully portable.

apps.name: Proton VPN
apps.notes: Needs a service/TAP driver; not fully portable.

apps.name: Meta Quest Link
apps.notes: Needs Oculus service/driver; not fully portable.

apps.name: Cheat Engine
apps.notes: Use only with games you are allowed to modify.

apps.name: FiveM
apps.notes: FiveM keeps everything under %LOCALAPPDATA%\FiveM; use FiveM Portable Setup for per-PC sharing.
